---
title: "8. Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning and Learning in Games"
---

::: {.module-meta}
**Duration:** 10 weeks  
**Outcome:** Analyse strategic learning when multiple agents adapt simultaneously.
:::

## Core topics

Fictitious play; replicator dynamics; multiplicative weights; no-regret learning; correlated equilibrium; stochastic games; MARL; self-play; opponent modelling.

## Essential resources

- Fudenberg, D., & Levine, D. K. (1998). *The Theory of Learning in Games*. MIT Press.
- MIT **6.S890: Topics in Multiagent Learning** — <https://www.mit.edu/~gfarina/6S890/>
- Zhang, K., Yang, Z., & Başar, T. (2019). Multi-agent reinforcement learning: A selective overview of theories and algorithms. <https://arxiv.org/abs/1911.10635>

## Milestone

Create an artificial market populated by adaptive agents and compare learned outcomes with economic equilibrium benchmarks.
